mechanism: Oxybutynin is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase levonorgestrel metabolism unpredictably, potentially reducing contraceptive efficacy, while anticholinergic effects may also impair GI absorption of oral contraceptives.
action: Consider alternative anticholinergic agents (e.g., tolterodine) or advise additional contraceptive precautions; monitor for breakthrough bleeding as a sign of reduced contraceptive effectiveness.
